entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.1387 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M, Bolangir, arising out Bolangir Town P.S. Case No.482 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 406/420/506 IPC.
3.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

4. Taking into account that the Petitioner has criminal proclivity inasmuch as he has been cited as an accused in Patnagarh P.S. Case No.151 of 2023 under Sections 342/ 365/ 366/ 370/ 376(2)(n)/
420/ 506/ 34 IPC, this Court is not inclined to entertain the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

However,
ABLAPL is disposed of with the observation that the Petitioner may surrender before the learned S.D.J.M, Bolangir in connection with the aforementioned case within one month from today.
5. In the event of his surrender and motion for bail, the application for bail shall be considered by the learned S.D.J.M, Bolangir on merits in accordance with law in the first hour of the day.
In the event of rejection of the prayer for bail by the learned S.D.J.M, Bolangir, the Petitioner is at liberty to move the higher forum for bail in the second hour on the same day.
6. On being so moved, the higher forum shall dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the Nilambar Padhan vs State Of Odisha ....
